title: LearnUP Kafka Event Envelope Contract
description: Standardized event envelope wrapping all asynchronous Kafka event messages across LearnUP microservices.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the event instance. Used by consumers to guarantee idempotent execution.

eventType.description: Canonical name and version of the event type following the dot-delimited topic naming standard.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the domain event occurred in the producer service.

producer.description: Originating microservice name that emitted the event.

organizationId.description: Standardized tenant organization identifier for tenant-scoped partitioning and multi-tenant routing.

correlationId.description: Distributed trace correlation token propagated across synchronous HTTP and asynchronous event flows.
